summary: A light, swift, Deva-gana nakshatra of the healer twins: the Moon here gives a person who is good-looking, fond of adornment, lucky, capable and intelligent, with a gift for speed and healing.
rare_outcomes: birth in its first 2 ghatikas falls in the Revati-Ashwini nakshatra gandanta (BPHS 92.3)

by_area.personality: Attractive, fond of adornment, capable and intelligent (BJ 16.1); Frawley adds speed, vitality and innovation.
by_area.career: Mundane allotment (BS 15.26): horse keepers and dealers, riders, army commanders, physicians, servants, traders. Frawley: suits doctors, psychologists and innovative leaders.
by_area.health: Frawley: its power is healing that frees the world of disease (a theme, not a health prediction).
by_area.spirituality: Frawley: transformation through balance and rejuvenation.

attributes.deity: Ashvins (Ashvini Kumaras), the twin physicians [BS 98.4-5; BPHS 6.24-26 'Dastra'; PVR; Frawley]
attributes.symbol: Horse's head [conventional; Wikipedia List of Nakshatras, uncited (via summary)]
attributes.gana: Deva [Dharma Sindhu, Vivaha Prakarana (condensed tr., Kamakoti)]
attributes.nature: Laghu / Kshipra (light, swift): BS 98.9; Raman, Muhurtha appendix

as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.1) gives the person born with the Moon in Ashwini a love of ornaments, a handsome form, good fortune, competence and intelligence; every trait is favourable.

padas.note: Its opening 2 ghatikas (about 48 minutes) are the Revati-Ashwini nakshatra gandanta; BPHS 92.1 says birth then threatens life [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]; remedies in 92.6-11 and 94.8-9.

conditional_results.when: manual: birth in the first 2 ghatikas of Ashwini (Revati-Ashwini nakshatra gandanta)
effects: [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]
remedial rites prescribed for the child

remedies.remedy: for nakshatra gandanta birth: gift of a cow with calf; worship of the nakshatra deity's gold image on a kalasha with homa and abhisheka (with the father if born in the first part, the mother if in the second); feeding Brahmins
two cows in charity for the Revati-Ashwini gandanta

disagreements: Little disagreement on character: BJ and Frawley both stress capability and vitality. Lord and deity agree across BS 98, BPHS and PVR.
phrasing_guidance: Present the classical traits as tendencies of the Moon's nakshatra, one factor among many (sign, house, aspects and dasha all modify it). Soften harsh classical words into plain, non-judgemental language; never tell a user they are 'wicked', a 'thief' or 'ungrateful'. Mention gandanta only as a traditional caution with its remedy, never as a threat to a child's life.

summary: A fierce nakshatra ruled by Yama, yet Varahamihira gives its natives resolve, truthfulness, health, skill and contentment; its theme is carrying things through to their end.

by_area.personality: Resolute, truthful, capable and contented (BJ 16.1). Frawley: discipline, sacrifice, removal of what has run its course.
by_area.career: Mundane allotment (BS 15.27): gem dealers, pulse dealers, meat-eaters, people who delight in cruelty, the low-minded.
by_area.spirituality: Frawley: linked to yoga, discipline, sacrifice and the ancestral line.

disagreements: BJ's natal portrait is wholly favourable, while BS 15 (mundane) and the muhurta rules (BS 98.8; Raman) treat Bharani as fierce and unfit for good work. They answer different questions: the natal verse describes the person, the muhurta rule the quality of a time.
phrasing_guidance: Present the classical traits as tendencies of the Moon's nakshatra, one factor among many (sign, house, aspects and dasha all modify it). Soften harsh classical words into plain, non-judgemental language; never tell a user they are 'wicked', a 'thief' or 'ungrateful'. Do not carry Bharani's muhurta reputation (bad for starting work) into a judgement of the person.

summary: Agni's mixed soft-and-sharp nakshatra: the Moon here gives a radiant, well-known person with a big appetite and strong desires; its power is to burn and purify.
rare_outcomes: a girl born on a Saturday in Krittika on the 7th tithi is called Visha Kanya (BPHS 80.43)

by_area.personality: Vigorous and radiant, with a strong appetite and strong desires (BJ 16.2).
by_area.career: Mundane allotment (BS 15.1): performers of sacrifices, Brahmins, priests, potters, astronomers.
by_area.relationships: BJ 16.2 warns of attraction to others' spouses.
by_area.spirituality: Frawley: burning and purification (dahana shakti); burns away negativity.

disagreements: BJ mixes praise (radiance, fame) with a moral caution (others' spouses); Frawley gives only the purifying-fire theme. Krittika straddles Aries and Taurus.
phrasing_guidance: Present the classical traits as tendencies of the Moon's nakshatra, one factor among many (sign, house, aspects and dasha all modify it). Soften harsh classical words into plain, non-judgemental language; never tell a user they are 'wicked', a 'thief' or 'ungrateful'. Never use 'Visha Kanya' as a label for a woman; at most note an old rule that many charts cancel.

summary: The creator's fixed nakshatra of growth: the Moon here gives a truthful, clean, sweet-spoken, steady-minded and good-looking person; its theme is fertility and flourishing.

by_area.personality: Truthful, clean, sweet-spoken, steady and attractive (BJ 16.2).
by_area.career: Mundane allotment (BS 15.2): devout people, merchants, rulers, the rich, yogis, drivers, cattle owners, farmers.
by_area.finance: Frawley: brings prosperity and helps projects flourish.
by_area.relationships: Frawley: good for procreation and reunion with loved ones, though it can stir jealousy and desire.

summary: Aditi's nakshatra of renewal: the Moon here gives a self-controlled, happy, good-natured person who is content with little; BJ adds slow understanding and a tendency to illness.

by_area.personality: Self-controlled, happy, good-natured and easily satisfied (BJ 16.4).
by_area.career: Mundane allotment (BS 15.5): truthful, generous, clean, well-born, wise, famous and wealthy people; merchants of fine goods; servants; associates of painters and sculptors.
by_area.health: BJ 16.4 names proneness to illness and thirst.
by_area.spirituality: Frawley: renewal like the return of the rains; fertility; the cosmic Mother.

phrasing_guidance: Present the classical traits as tendencies of the Moon's nakshatra, one factor among many (sign, house, aspects and dasha all modify it). Soften harsh classical words into plain, non-judgemental language; never tell a user they are 'wicked', a 'thief' or 'ungrateful'.

summary: Savitr's light nakshatra of the hand: the Moon here gives an energetic, bold, enterprising person; BJ adds drink, harshness and theft, while Frawley stresses reaching goals quickly.
common_outcomes: gets what it seeks into its own hands (Frawley)

by_area.personality: Energetic and bold (BJ 16.7), with harsher traits in the same verse.
by_area.career: Mundane allotment (BS 15.11): thieves, elephant dealers, charioteers, chief ministers, painters, merchants, scholars of the shastras.
by_area.spirituality: Frawley: Savitr inspires yoga and the path to enlightenment; aim high.

attributes.deity: Savitr, the Sun [BS 98.4-5; BPHS 6.24-26 'Surya'; Frawley]; PVR Table 2 gives Vishwakarma

attributes.nature: Laghu (light): BS 98.9 and Raman; the Iyer translation of BS 98.11 also lists Hasta among the asterisms for 'works of a moving character'

as_moon: BJ 16.7: the Moon in Hasta gives energy, boldness, fondness for drink, harshness and a thieving tendency.

disagreements: BJ is mixed-to-negative while Frawley is positive. The Iyer translation of BS 98 lists Hasta both as light (v. 9) and among the 'moving' asterisms (v. 11); Raman lists it only as light. The word ghrini can also mean compassionate or contemptuous; Neely gives 'wild'. Deity: PVR's Table 2 gives Vishwakarma.
phrasing_guidance: Present the classical traits as tendencies of the Moon's nakshatra, one factor among many (sign, house, aspects and dasha all modify it). Soften harsh classical words into plain, non-judgemental language; never tell a user they are 'wicked', a 'thief' or 'ungrateful'. Present Hasta as resourcefulness and skill of hand; do not relay 'thief' or 'drinker'.

summary: Tvashtr's soft nakshatra of craft and beauty: the Moon here gives a person with fine eyes and an elegant body who loves colourful clothes and garlands; its theme is skilled making and merit.

by_area.personality: Attractive and fond of colourful dress and garlands (BJ 16.8).
by_area.career: Mundane allotment (BS 15.12): jewel and fine-cloth dealers, writers, singers, perfumers, mathematicians, weavers, surgeons, eye doctors. Frawley: arts and crafts.
by_area.spirituality: Frawley: accumulating merit (punya cayani); righteousness applied in action.

attributes.deity: Tvashtr, the divine craftsman [BS 98.4-5; BPHS 6.24-26; Frawley]; PVR Table 2 gives Vayu
attributes.symbol: Bright jewel or pearl [conventional; Wikipedia List of Nakshatras, uncited (via summary)]
attributes.gana: Rakshasa [Dharma Sindhu, Vivaha Prakarana (condensed tr., Kamakoti)]

as_moon: BJ 16.8: the Moon in Chitra gives a person who wears variegated clothes and garlands and has beautiful eyes and limbs.
